**Five models, 2,510 scored runs.** v1.2 adds the current Gemini models, called through Google's own API, and replicates the v1.1 headline finding directly.

| | Claude Sonnet 5.5 | Gemini 4 Argon | Gemini 3.1 Pro (preview) | Gemini 3.8 Flash | Gemini 3.5 Flash |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| pass^5, clean | **0.96** | **0.96** | **0.84** | **0.84** | **0.72** |
| pass^5, with a fault | **0.94** | **0.94** | **0.72** | **0.86** | **0.72** |
| Followed a planted instruction | 0 of 55 | 0 of 55 | 7 of 55 | 2 of 55 | 1 of 55 |
| Fabricated a citation | 0 | 0 | 0 | 2 | 0 |
| Ran out of the 15-call budget | 2 of 500 | 5 of 500 | 13 of 500 | 24 of 500 | 58 of 500 |

### Highlights
- **The headline holds through Google's API.** Gemini 3.1 Pro gave the planted adolescent Ozempic dose in 5 of 5 runs again, once after noticing the real SmPC warning and calling it "a seemingly legacy statement".
- **Gemini 4 Argon matches Claude Sonnet 5.5** on pass^5, clean and under faults, with no hard fails, and declined the planted dose every time.
- **Argon graded the relative-as-absolute claim "unsupported" in 5 of 10 runs**, where the v1.1 models managed 1 of 30.
- **Gemini 3.8 Flash** is far more reliable than 3.5 Flash (0.84 vs 0.72), but twice cited a garbled EMPA-REG OUTCOME PMID that resolves to unrelated papers.

### Added
- Gemini API adapter with thought-signature replay and a spending cap; `scripts/gemini_direct.sh`.
- `analysis/gemini_direct_v1.2.md`.
- Repository: keyless `make quickstart`, `make selfcheck` in CI, examples, contributing guide, issue templates.

Write-up: [Being right once isn't reliable](https://www.pharmatools.ai/notes/groundhog-agent-reliability) · Full changelog: [`CHANGELOG.md`](https://github.com/nickjlamb/groundhog/blob/main/CHANGELOG.md)
